{{Quote|And to my son, Nield, my treasure, my hope, I leave my love and my undying hatred for the filthy Melida&mdash;|Hologram of Leidra|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path]]''</ref>}}
'''Leidra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. Daughter of [[Pei]] and wife of [[Micae]], she was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of four sons, the youngest of which was [[Nield]]. After leaving five-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old Nield with [[Nield's cousin|his cousin]], she left to fight and [[Death/Legends|die]] in a battle against the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after her husband and three older sons had died in a similar battle. A [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Leidra was placed in a [[Hall of Evidence]] over [[Lake Weir]] in the [[Outer Circle]] region around Melida/Daan's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Zehava]].
